notes: Compiled from Clash of Clans / Clash Royale / Boom Beach Fandom wikis where fetches succeeded (Monolith, Ricochet Cannon, Multi-Archer Tower, Multi-Gear Tower, Firespitter, Spell Tower, Tornado Trap, Giga Bomb are 'verified': true and reflect live wiki data at fetch time) and from prior game knowledge otherwise (marked 'verified': false; treat exact numbers as approximate, especially for Builder Base X-Bow, Clan Capital buildings, Clash Royale non-tournament fields, and Boom Beach Prototype defenses, whose current live values were not re-checked this session). Clash of Clans Town Hall 18 (2026) reportedly introduced a 'Crafted Defenses' customization system rather than confirmed brand-new named buildings beyond TH17's Monolith/Ricochet Cannon/Multi-Gear Tower/Firespitter; TH18-specific stats were not available/fetchable this session and are omitted rather than fabricated. CR stats target tournament-standard level 11. Levels above 1 for many entries are the practical in-game max at time of writing, not guaranteed exact for the current patch.
